recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy sports composite featuring three athletes in dynamic action poses set against a stylized, monochromatic city skyline and explosive red smoke clouds. The composition is anchored by a large, bold typographic header at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Athletes positioned in a triangular formation for balanced visual weight
Red smoke clouds acting as a transition between the subjects and the dark background
High-contrast lighting on athletes to separate them from the atmospheric environment
Bold, heavy typography dominating the upper third of the frame
coreInvariants: Silhouetted city skyline in the background
Extremely tight kerning in the primary display text
High-detail athletic textures (skin, fabric, basketball leather)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three athletes at mid-ground; the central figure is slightly lower, creating a 'V' or 'W' shape with the outer figures who are in mid-air or lunging.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, horizontally-spanning title text at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top title, drop to the central athlete, then sweep left and right to the flanking players following their directional motion.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space at the very top and bottom edges, with dense red atmospheric texture in the center.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red mid-tones with extreme value contrast between the white uniforms and black background.

letterConstructionRules: Negative tracking causing characters to touch or overlap
Sheared or italicized stance for a sense of speed
Thick black outer stroke to separate text from the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters merged into a single continuous block
Numerical digits integrated into the wordmark with color changes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a massive, touching display face and a small, airy condensed subtitle.
graphicDevices: Color blocking within the same word

avoid: Wide letter spacing for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, moody sports background with a black top fading into a deep red smoky atmosphere. In the distance, include a faint, dark silhouette of a city skyline with glowing red lights. Place three basketball players in high-action poses (dribbling, jumping) in the mid-ground, lit with sharp rim lights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, italicized sans-serif title at the top. The letters must be so close they touch, with a thick black outline. Use a two-tone color scheme for the text (white for the first half, red for the second). Below it, add a small, wide-tracked condensed subtitle in white.

verificationChecks: Main title characters are touching or overlapping
Red smoke effect is vibrant but doesn't obscure the players' faces
City skyline is visible but low-contrast
Lighting on players is consistent with a studio flash setup

adjustableVariables: Number of athletes in the montage
mustRedesign: Player likenesses to avoid IP issues
postGenerationChecks: Is the text legible despite the tight tracking?
Do the players feel integrated into the smoke?
Is the red color consistent across the background and text?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject in Action] + [Atmospheric Smoke/Particle Effect] + [Silhouetted Environment] + [Ultra-Bold Overlapping Typography] using a [High Contrast Triadic Palette].
